thread:
kevin_sales: CloudBank just escalated — they need tenant-level visibility for billing disputes. Asking for a CSV export that shows per-tenant, per-route cost + token counts + latency percentiles, and a link back to a trace/span for any sample row. They want ETA and acceptance criteria. @maria_pm can you triage?

maria_pm: Thanks Kevin. Quick clarifying q's: 1) time range (rolling window vs export date range)? 2) is CSV enough or they want UI drilldown? 3) data freshness SLA?

kevin_sales: They said CSV is fine for now (legal wants a ledger). Time range: arbitrary date range in the export. Freshness: ideally <4h but they said 24h is acceptable if it's significantly faster to ship.

jon_support: For background — they filed a billing dispute where per-tenant routing split wasn't visible. Right now our console shows account-level aggregates only; we don't surface route-level cost per tenant. Also they need the trace link to match a span_id we store in traces.
thread_continuation:
alex_eng: Technically doable. Proposal: add new endpoint /exports/usage?start=...&end=...&tenant_id=... that returns CSV rows: tenant_id, route, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, sample_trace_link. Implementation plan: (a) materialized daily rollups per tenant+route, (b) CSV generator that paginates and streams from S3. Prototype ~2w, full product ~3w including perms + flag. Need data team for rollups.

sara_data: We already emit telemetry_hourly with route and tenant tags, but we don't have a pre-aggregated tenant+route rollup. Materialized view of telemetry_hourly -> rollups table should be straightforward. Estimate: 1 data-engineer week + storage estimate ~ 2M rows/day for large customers (CloudBank has many tenants). Need retention policy discussion.

maria_pm: Prioritization note: this is high-impact (contract renewal talk next month). Proposal: ship an "export-only" MVP behind a feature flag, with acceptance criteria: 1) CSV export for arbitrary ranges, 2) sample_trace_link present for >=95% of rows, 3) docs + support playbook, 4) audit logs for exports. Also require opt-in for PII scrubbing.

kevin_sales: CloudBank ok with feature-flagged pilot and can sign up for billed pilot. They will accept 6h freshness if it helps ship faster.

alex_eng: We can support 6h near-realtime by falling back to recent events stream for last 6h and hourly rollups for older data. That meets SLA. For sample_trace_link we can join on a sampled span index; I'll add an assurance in docs about sampling.

jon_support: Please include an "export sample" button that produces a 100-row sample file so support and the customer can confirm format before a full export. Also add CSV schema in the docs.

maria_pm: Launch checklist (MVP): - API export endpoint + FF - Data rollup job + retention - CSV generator + sample export - Trace link column (with sampling note) - Docs + runbook - Audit logs & perms - PII scrub opt-in. Acceptance test: produce a 30-day CSV for CloudBank with matching totals to billing report.

alex_eng: Draft JIRA description (brief): "Tenant usage export: API + CSV for per-tenant/per-route cost and latency, includes sample_trace_link. Feature-flagged MVP, sample export UI, docs, audit logs. Owner: alex_eng. Est: 3 eng-weeks + 1 data-engineer week."

alex_eng: Quick CLI example for the export (will add to docs):

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/usage?tenant_id=cloudbank&start=2026-02-01&end=2026-02-28&format=csv" \
  -o cloudbank_feb.csv
```

jon_support: Can we make the FF tenant-scoped? we shouldn't enable globally. Also need a consent checkbox for PII at partner setup.

maria_pm: Agreed — tenant-scoped FF + opt-in. Kevin, can you confirm CloudBank will opt in?

kevin_sales: Confirmed — CloudBank will opt in for pilot and sign an NDA for trace links. They want data freshness <=6h for the pilot.

observability-bot: deploy-bot: created feature-flag "tenant-usage-export" (owner: alex_eng)

maria_pm: Next steps: Alex to create tickets for API + data + docs, set timeline for pilot (target: ship pilot in 3 weeks), Kevin to coordinate pilot contract, Jon to draft support playbook. I'll add this to the roadmap board with priority=high.

kevin_sales: thanks all. I'll loop legal and customer success and post updates here. :thumbsup:

jon_support: quick note for runbook: include steps to revoke any CSV and rotate keys if they contain unexpected PII.

maria_pm: good call. adding runbook item.

alex_eng: I'll post the tickets shortly.

kevin_sales: (reacted :eyes:)
